title: Other-years heading reads month first; message shortened

history.detail:
PASS: QA1 gate-1 audit, Sprint 55, commit 4d317e1 (HEAD, clean tree). Verdict: PASS. Sprint file: re-read fresh. Unchanged since /sprint-start (git diff c29cd6c..4d317e1 -- docs/sprints is empty). The version-diff rule does not apply: no criterion claims something arrives between two versions. Handoff: read via git show 4d317e1:docs/handoffs/sprint-55.md. Round 1 is present and quotes "VERIFY PASS (lint, typecheck, test, build) exit=0". My own re-run: npm run verify ended with exit=0. Test Files 55 passed, Tests 622 passed, lint 0 errors and 3 warnings. R1 (heading), met. display.ts eventsHeading's "below" case returns `Other years with events on ${month} ${day}`, using formatLongDate. formatLongDate's day is String(Number(day)), so there is no leading zero. The single function and the eventsPlacement guard are unchanged, and every other case returns EVENTS_HEADING. Tests cover July 4, November 25, March 3 and January 9. Strict grep for the old form (grep -rnE "Other years with ([0-9]|\$\{day\} )" app lib) gives exit=1, no matches. The handoff's looser pattern also matches the new strings because they contain "with events"; that's harmless, and the strict pattern is the real check. R2 (message), met. In accuracy.ts the unmatched case always returns next "Pick a different date.". The lookup-failed case ("Try again in a few minutes.") and the bold lead are unchanged, and Sprint 54's br is untouched in HoroscopeUnavailableSection. grep "choose one of the years listed" app lib gives exit=1. The accuracy tests cover the linkable, zero-event and pre-1700 cases. A dedicated test proves its own premise (one payload links for 4 July, the other doesn't), then asserts the exact next step for both. R3 (removals), met and confirmed truly unused: - hasLinkableYear: the only reader was unavailableMessage. - unavailableMessage's eventsHeading parameter, and the HoroscopeUnavailableSection eventsHeading prop. - horoscopeAvailability's isoDate parameter. Its only use was computing hasLinkableYear. Grep shows the only callers are app/date/[date]/page.tsx:110,136 and app/reading/[id]/page.tsx:87,98, all updated, and typecheck passes. Removing isoDate goes slightly past R3's literal list, but it is within R3's "remove what's now unused", and I accept it. The year links (linkableEventDate, EventYear) remain. The page tests still assert href="/date/1933-03-04" on /reading/[id] and the date-page links. The 29 February coverage still exists in the linkableEventDate test at accuracy.test.ts:43. The removed availability case only asserted the deleted field. R4 (tests), met. Unit, accuracy and render tests on both routes are updated. Each render test asserts the paragraph ends "
Pick a different date.

", so nothing can trail it. R5 (screenshots), met. I opened today-unmatched-1280 and today-unmatched-390. The heading reads "Other years with events on November 26", and at 390 it wraps to 2 lines with no overflow. The reading shows the bold lead, then "Pick a different date." on its own line, and nothing more. The year links show in green. Security and error handling: no new input paths, only string and plumbing changes. Open items, all pre-existing with Master Controller: - On /reading/[id] the message says "Pick a different date", but that page has no picker. This sprint makes it the only next step there, so the mismatch is more visible. It is out of scope. - The 3 lint warnings in earlier sprints' evidence scripts (sprint-45, sprint-46) are still not owned by any recorded decision. None of these blocks this sprint.
